description: Product Name: Power BI Baidu ECharts Bar Chart Visualization Object Version: 1.0.0 Release date: November 12, 2024 Developer: [Infortime Shiqin] Product Description: This product is an advanced visualization object designed specifically for Power BI users, utilizing the powerful features of Baidu ECharts to provide users with an intuitive and interactive bar chart display. This object not only supports basic bar chart display, but also provides rich customization options, including but not limited to data labels, legends, tooltips, and various interactive functions. Main functions: Data driven visualization: Users can directly drive bar charts through Power BI's data model to achieve dynamic data display. Highly customizable: Provides multiple customization options, including color, font, legend position, etc., to meet the display needs of different users. Interactivity: Supports interactive operations such as clicking and hovering, enhancing user experience. Responsive design: Bar charts can adapt to different display devices and resolutions. Multi language support: Supports multiple languages to meet the needs of global users.
